ries_flow_sensitivity_evidence.reason: The available Ries flow-sensitivity series was measured at 35.4% O2 and 60 kPa. Applying that relationship as a correction at 21% O2 and approximately 101.3 kPa would require an unsupported cross-condition extrapolation.

normal_gravity.reason: The source states that 1g experiments are governed by natural convection and that a directly comparable imposed-flow velocity cannot be assigned.

correction_policy.reason: No source-supported transfer function exists for converting the 100 mm/s Ries Figure 4 result to the 50 mm/s BASS-II reference condition at 21% O2 and approximately 101.3 kPa.

allowed_claim: Ries Figure 4 provides independent external comparison evidence, but its flow and transport conditions are not sufficiently matched for direct FireSense validation.
